description: Late Iron Age to Early Roman agricultural system, two structures were identified apart from the domestic focus. One a palisaded circle of post-holes, the other a rectangular post-holed structure. Both of Late Iron Age to Early Roman date, function is uncertain, but apparently tentative religious evidence, the RSRB identifies the site as a 'shrine'.
bibliography: Boulter, and Walton Rogers. “Circles and Cemeteries: Excavations at Flixton.” East Anglian Archaeology 147 (2008). https://doi.org/10.5284/1021993.
Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Barnham (Suffolk).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
